message: Confirmed both bugs still present in src/ (not just the published 0.2.0 tarball). Fixed .rw-select-popover to width:max-content; min-width:var(--trigger-width) (was hard-pinned to trigger width), plus a white-space:nowrap/overflow:hidden/text-overflow:ellipsis fallback on .rw-option [slot=label] for the pathological case beyond the existing 100vw-24px popover cap. Added hideLabel?:boolean to Select (src/controls.tsx) and MultiSelect (src/inputs.tsx): label keeps aria-labelledby wiring but swaps class rw-label -> rw-sr-only, removing it from flex layout flow entirely.

Added tests/browser/select-regressions.spec.ts (2 tests). Key finding while writing them: the docs catalogue's default 'select' page example is a false-negative host for the R1 repro because .rw-select-trigger is width:100% of a wide card there, already wider than most long labels; R1 only reproduces with a content-sized/compact trigger (e.g. inside .rw-inline), so both the fixture and the test use the new #showcase 'A tidy toolbar' Gallery card instead. Verified against pre-fix CSS (temporarily reverted via page.addStyleTag) that the long option previously rendered at 115.5px tall (wrapped) vs 37.5px post-fix (single line), and that the popover was stuck at exactly --trigger-width pre-fix. Added a hideLabel toolbar Storybook story (stories/inputs.stories.tsx: SelectToolbar). npm run check (types, 11 unit tests, 63 examples, build) and npm run test:browser (15/15, incl. light/dark axe over the updated catalogue+Gallery pages) pass. Bumped package.json to 0.2.1; npm pack --dry-run produces a clean react-wardrobe-0.2.1.tgz (24 files). Recorded in VERIFICATION.md. No npm publish performed.

Semantic verification (read code + ran tests, not spec-only): R1 PASS - src/styles.css:296-299 (.rw-select-popover{width:max-content;min-width:var(--trigger-width)}) and :327-331 (.rw-option [slot=label] ellipsis fallback); tests/browser/select-regressions.spec.ts:3-25 passed, confirmed against reverted pre-fix CSS it actually catches the regression (115.5px wrapped vs 37.5px fixed). R2 PASS - src/controls.tsx:168,183,198 and src/inputs.tsx:75,82,97 (hideLabel toggles rw-label->rw-sr-only, aria-labelledby wiring untouched); select-regressions.spec.ts:27-40 passed (toolbar vertical alignment <2px, label box <=1px). R3 PASS - npm run check clean, npm run test:browser 15/15 incl. axe, stories/inputs.stories.tsx SelectToolbar story present, package.json version 0.2.1, npm pack --dry-run clean 24-file tarball. Structural + semantic verification both green; tasks.md checkboxes flipped to [x] so specocd approve's gate is satisfied.
